metadata.question: On February 14, 2023, were nighttime lights in central Antakya, the capital of Türkiye’s Hatay Province, brighter than those around Hatay Airport?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band, “Composited”, version 1. - Date: exact calendar day 14 Feb 2023 → use the single-day “vcm-orm-nt” collection (no compositing). - Location: two points – central Antakya (lat ≈ 36.23°, lon ≈ 36.15°) and Hatay Airport (lat ≈ 36.36°, lon ≈ 36.27°). 2. Masking: - VIIRS DNB already masks cloudy pixels via the “avg_rad” band (cloud = NaN), so no extra cloud mask is needed. - We simply read avg_rad; any NaN → C2 / C3. 3. Logic: - Compute mean radiance for a 500 m neighbourhood around each point. - If either collection is empty → C1. - After extraction, if any mean is NaN or pixel count is 0 → C3. - Compare Central vs Airport; if Central > Airport → A (Yes), else → B (No). ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & date antakya = ee.Geometry.Point(36.15, 36.23) # central Antakya airport = ee.Geometry.Point(36.27, 36.36) # Hatay Airport date = '2023-02-14' # 2. Data acquisition col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \ .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print("No VIIRS image for 2023-02-14.") print("C1") else: img = col.first() scale = 500 # sensor native ~500 m stat = lambda geom: img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom.buffer(scale*2), scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad') valA = stat(antakya).getInfo() valB = stat(airport).getInfo() print(f"Antakya: {valA:.2f}, Airport: {valB:.2f}") if valA is None or valB is None or valA != valA or valB != valB: print("C3") else: print("A" if valA > valB else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & date
antakya = ee.Geometry.Point(36.15, 36.23)  # central Antakya
airport = ee.Geometry.Point(36.27, 36.36)  # Hatay Airport
date = '2023-02-14'

# 2. Data acquisition
col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') \
        .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day'))
n = col.size().getInfo()
if n == 0:
    print("No VIIRS image for 2023-02-14.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    img = col.first()
    scale = 500  # sensor native ~500 m
    stat = lambda geom: img.reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(),
                                         geometry=geom.buffer(scale*2),
                                         scale=scale,
                                         maxPixels=1e9).get('avg_rad')
    valA = stat(antakya).getInfo()
    valB = stat(airport).getInfo()
    print(f"Antakya: {valA:.2f}, Airport: {valB:.2f}")
    if valA is None or valB is None or valA != valA or valB != valB:
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if valA > valB else "<answer>B</answer>")
